-- Phase 2: implementations. Signatures and contracts are unchanged from Phase 1.

-- Advance the seeded state and return the next value (non-negative).
-- Lehmer generator: multiplier 48271, modulus 2^31 - 1 (prime).
-- state < 2^31, so state * 48271 < 2^47 and cannot overflow.
mix(state: int) -> int =
  pre state >= 0
  post out >= 0
  ex mix(0) == mix(0)
  (state * 48271) % 2147483647

-- True when no value appears more than once in xs.
all_distinct(xs: List[int]) -> bool =
  ex all_distinct([1, 2, 3]) == True
  ex all_distinct([1, 1]) == False
  for i in range(0, xs.len())
    for j in range(i + 1, xs.len())
      if xs[i] == xs[j]
        return False
  True

-- n distinct ids, the same list on every run for the same seed. No capabilities.
make_ids(n: int, seed: int) -> List[int] =
  pre n >= 0
  post out.len() == n
  post all_distinct(out)
  ex make_ids(0, 7) == []
  ex make_ids(2, 5) == make_ids(2, 5)
  -- Start in 1 .. 2147483646 so the Lehmer state is never zero.
  var state = seed % 2147483646 + 1
  var out: List[int] = []
  while out.len() < n
    state = mix(state)
    var ok = True
    for x in out
      if x == state
        ok = False
    if ok
      out.append(state)
  out
